items.title: Joe Mares Jr. Interview, 1960-04-08
items.q: I had the Johnny Saint-Cien, Paul Barber, George Lewis, and all the big names as guests.

ctx.x: I understand that you helped Lizzie Miles with her comeback too.

Yes, I did, Bill. Well, Lizzie had been retired about 13 years. And she was working a little spot, wasn't doing too good. And Lizzie was dying to make a comeback. She rode a couple of disc jockeys here, didn't pay any attention to her. Well, I had a little radio program of my own for four and a half years, plugging Dixieland at WSMB. And I also took a little time on Tony Almerickas. Tony at that time was ill. So I went on for him for two weeks. In the meantime, I had the Johnny Saint-Cien, Paul Barber, George…
Jubilee. I was going to ask about those trips that you made out there too.
